description: Check words and a salt against a witness stone: recomputes sha256(salt + NUL + normalizedText) and compares it with the stone's commitment, and rechecks the stone's chain link. A pure hash check: nothing is stored or revealed. To publish the words, POST the reveal route instead.

salt.description: The private salt used for the commitment.

text.description: The words as sealed (1-280 code points after normalization).

name: verify_witness
title: Check a witness stone
